context: Class wrap-up on the diplomacy unit citing leadership and proposals
purpose: Teach: 主導/両国/受け入れる/速報/死に/努め/跡/予報

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: では外交ユニットのまとめに入ります。両国の関係を扱った事例をいくつか見てきましたね。
lines.en: Now let's wrap up the diplomacy unit. We've looked at several cases dealing with relations between the two countries.
lines.style: Calm classroom voice, measured and professional pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、昨日のニュース速報で、首脳会談の続報が入っていましたよね。
lines.en: Sensei, in yesterday's news flash, there was a follow-up on the summit, right?
lines.style: Bright teen voice, eager and slightly proud to contribute.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: よく見ていましたね。あの会談を主導したのは、まさにリーダーシップの好例です。
lines.en: You were watching closely. The way that meeting was led is a perfect example of leadership.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging teacher tone with gentle approval.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 提案を受け入れるかどうかで、ずっと議論が続いていて、見ているこっちが死にそうでした。
lines.en: They kept arguing about whether to accept the proposal, and watching it was honestly exhausting.
lines.style: Animated teenage delivery with a half-laughing complaint.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史の跡をたどると、似た交渉が何度もあったんですよ。先人たちは合意形成に努めてきました。
lines.en: If you trace the marks of history, there have been many similar negotiations. Our predecessors strove to build consensus.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower pace as she draws on history.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど。じゃあレポートでは、両首脳の提案と、その背景をまとめればいいですか？
lines.en: I see. So for the report, should I summarize both leaders' proposals and their background?
lines.style: Curious student tone, rising intonation seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はい、それで十分です。あ、それと窓を閉めて。天気予報だと午後から雨だそうですよ。
lines.en: Yes, that will be enough. Oh, and close the window please. The weather forecast says it'll rain this afternoon.
lines.style: Practical teacher voice shifting smoothly into a casual reminder.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 了解です！じゃあ放課後、図書室で資料探してから帰ります。
lines.en: Got it! Then after class I'll search for materials in the library before heading home.
lines.style: Cheerful, energetic teen sign-off with forward momentum.
